operatingOrganisation.name: Institute of Landscape Ecology, Slovak Academy of Sciences

general.abstract: Acid alpine grassland on a ridge extending westward from the summit of Mount Kralova Hola in Low Tatra Mountains, Slovakia. Vegetation at the site belong to the alliance Juncion trifidi and it is dominated by graminoid species, including Oreochloa disticha, Festuca supina and Agrostis rupestris, with lower cover of forb and dwarf shrub species.

eunisHabitat.label: Grasslands and lands dominated by forbs, mosses or lichens (E)

infrastructure.notes: Climatic station and open-top chambers installed permanently, other equipment used for campaign measurements
